candidates.title: Persona Archetype Selection Grid Layout
candidates.change: Redesign the choose_path step into an interactive grid of pet archetype cards to help users select their ideal companion faster.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has a 78.0% conversion rate with a mean completion time of 514s, indicating decision hesitation.

guard.reason: replacement for 'choose_path.path_options' does not do the job (two distinct choices: adopting a friend and making your own): needs 2 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Relocate Sign-In After Companion Assembly Waiting
candidates.change: Move the sign_in step to occur after the waiting step so users register their account only after pet assembly finishes.
candidates.why: Sign-in drops 22.6% of starting users; placing registration after asset creation builds commitment before requiring credentials.

guard.reason: Moving sign_in to occur after the waiting step is allowed inside onboarding and retains all required steps.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign-in after pet assembly leverages user investment, targeting a 22.6% drop.

candidates.title: Post-Onboarding Pet Interaction Skill Showcase Screen
candidates.change: Add a new interactive tutorial screen right after home_intro that demonstrates desktop pet controls, hiding, and talking.
candidates.why: Support received multiple tickets complaining that users do not know how to control, talk to, or hide their pet after setup.

guard.reason: _order names screens that are neither onboarding screens nor defined here: ['new_pet_skills_tutorial']

candidates.title: Multi-Step Pet Personality & Aesthetic Builder Flow
candidates.change: Introduce a interactive multi-option carousel flow on the pick_friend screen for selecting pet color palette and temperament traits.
candidates.why: Adoption stage drops 26.3% of users and takes an average of 1017s due to complex custom pet options.

guard.reason: Redesigning pick_friend with a carousel to choose pet traits and color still fulfills the job of choosing a pet.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has high drop-off (26.3%) and 1017s mean time; structured flow eases setup.

candidates.title: Account Data Preservation & Re-Login Reassurance Banner
candidates.change: Display explicit security and pet persistence reassurance text on the sign_in card.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing back in.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Protect Your Pet
sign_in.body: Your adoptable companions and customized assets are securely linked to your profile and preserved across reinstalls.
sign_in.hint: Existing pets sync automatically upon authentication.

guard.reason: Adding reassurance copy regarding data preservation on the sign_in screen is allowed and complies with fair design rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong support email signal (8 tickets); simple copy change reassures returning users.

candidates.title: Pre-Launch Desktop Overlay Compatibility Checklist
candidates.change: Show an active system compatibility checklist component during the waiting screen to verify screen permissions and overlay window settings.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported that pets fail to appear on desktop or the app stutters at launch.

guard.reason: Modifying waiting-screen information and components to show engine initialization and compatibility checks is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Home step conversion is already high (93.5%), so potential recovery is limited.

candidates.title: Story Intro Companion Path Overview Tip
candidates.change: Add an explanatory badge and guide hint to the story screen highlighting how path choices influence pet behavior.
candidates.why: The choose_path mean time of 514s indicates users spend considerable time unsure about path differences.

story.headline: Welcome to Desktop Pets
story.hint: Each path unlocks unique traits and desktop interactions.

guard.reason: Adding guide hints and badges to the story screen is an allowed onboarding design change.

candidates.score_note: High mean time (514s) points to user hesitation on path choice; visual tips reduce hesitation.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Signature & Verification Card
candidates.change: Rebuild the adoption_certificate screen using a spotlight layout with a prominent adoption badge component.
candidates.why: The adoption stage loses over 26% of candidates, requiring a stronger visual feeling of achievement upon naming the pet.

guard.reason: replacement for 'adoption_certificate.certificate' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'preview'] with an asset:certificate/ asset

candidates.title: Interactive Audio Toy Playground During Download
candidates.change: Embed a sound button and toy preview animation on the waiting screen so users can interact with companion sounds while assets build.
candidates.why: The home waiting step takes a mean of 2336s, leading to drop-offs during asset loading.

guard.reason: Adding interactive audio and animation components to the waiting screen during pet creation is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Home wait time is extremely long (2336s), but home drop-off rate is relatively low.

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Shortcut Keys Visual Summary
candidates.change: Display explicit keyboard shortcut hints and tray location instructions on the home_intro screen.
candidates.why: Support received multiple messages regarding confusion on how to control or minimize the companion after onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Active on Desktop!
home_intro.hint: Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime to open controls or send your pet to the system tray.

components.text: System Tray: Right-click the pet icon to manage controls

guard.reason: Adding keyboard shortcut hints and desktop tray instructions to home_intro is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Finish step loses 29.1% of users and support reports post-onboarding confusion.
